claims.statement: Joe Coburn said he would have nothing to do with Tom Allen, either bare-fisted or with gloves.
claims.excerpt: burn will have nothing to do with Allen.

claims.statement: It was rumoured in fistic circles that Tom Allen had sent Joe Coburn a telegram that morning.

claims.statement: Tom Allen was expected back in St. Louis from Chicago by Monday, 24 April.
claims.excerpt: Allen will be in this citv by Monday,

notes: Most of the article is Joe Coburn's engagements and refusal, which is left out. The Chicago trip is stated as expected, not confirmed.
